app.title: Show HN: Persistent Jupyter kernel execution and live output streaming in VSCode
app.author: rnoro_
app.description: A CLI and VSCode extension that keeps Jupyter kernels running persistently across sessions, streaming live output to the editor.
proposed_tests: pip install tithon, run `tithon --help` to verify CLI availability
Start a Jupyter kernel with `tithon start` and ensure it stays alive after VSCode restarts
Execute a long-running notebook cell and confirm live output streams to the editor
Measure kernel restart time compared to standard `jupyter` launch
